answer: Retroactive Co-Activity Plume Analysis: after each epoch, the system clusters identities by a shared behavioral beacon (timing, call graphs, phrasing). A cluster whose members co-occur far above chance is flagged; every flagged identity’s accumulated rewards are frozen and its reputation reset, not just the new accounts. A fable of “independent actors” fails once the whole cluster is scored jointly. Attacker cost: re-earning reputation across N linked identities each cycle, plus losing all prior epoch rewards on detection.
